sources_checked: docs/creativity-screening/search/seed-openalex-citing.md (report 'OpenAlex works since 2025-01-01 that cite eight anchor experiments', dated 2026-10-04)
coverage_limits: The report covers only OpenAlex works dated 2025-01-01 to 2026-10-04 that OpenAlex links as citing eight anchor experiments, and it lists only the 90 most relevant of about 265 shortlisted works; citation links are incomplete, so preprints with unparsed reference lists are missed, and three anchor versions have no OpenAlex record. Labels rest on titles and abstract excerpts (about 30 percent of works had no usable abstract, and 25 of the 90 rows depend on titles alone), randomization labels rely on abstract wording, and many SSRN and book records carry placeholder dates such as 2025-01-01.
